Bettina Kroll: Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 2025-11-02 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". So the date for your coverage tracker is **November 3, 2025**.

The digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner. Its wording is "account ownership changes hands." It's also a plan written the day before, so it doesn't confirm the handoff actually happened that day.

The digests use "PHL" for both Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Covey & Lark Retail, so make sure you're logging the right account.
